name: Tractor Supply Distribution Center Waverly NE

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled checkpoint where the entry boulevard pinches between the employee parking lot and the secured trailer yard; chain-link perimeter fence rings the whole truck yard (clearly visible in 2025 Street View frames).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small ~1-2 vehicle-footprint gatehouse on a median island at the parking/yard checkpoint, visible at z20 satellite (40.9035, -96.5476) splitting inbound/outbound lanes.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run the full length of BOTH the east and west long walls (cross-dock layout), so shipping and receiving operate from physically separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided entry boulevard with landscaped median and ample paved apron at the gate; physical room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron between the inner gate and the dock faces provides interior queue/holding space.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large banks of marked trailer-parking rows at the north end full of bobtail trailers, plus a second drop row along the west dock side.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~50-60 doors per long face (east + west) from z19 imagery; both walls fully docked. Banded 50+; exact count approximate.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad identified in the truck path; left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural setting but inside a developed industrial park near Waverly/I-80 corridor; cellular coverage likely adequate, so left false (medium confidence).
fieldNotes.railServed: A through rail line runs ~300m+ south of the property through farmland but no spur enters the site.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC plus a smaller secondary building at the NW (offices/maintenance) inside the property.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Divided boulevard reads as roughly 1 in / 1 out at the checkpoint; lane count approximate from overhead.
